controls.rotateClockwise: rotate the satellite clockwise around the axis
controls.hardDrop: drop the pair to the lowest free cell

game.gravityMode: connected groups fall after a clear; re-evaluate chains
game.connectionRule: 4 or more orthogonally adjacent same-color puyo are cleared

scoring.chainBonus: increases with chain length and color count
scoring.simultaneousBonus: bonus for clearing several colors at once
scoring.allClearBonus: bonus when the board is emptied

game.winCondition: the opponent's spawn column is blocked by settled puyo
game.lossCondition: own spawn cannot place a new pair
game.matchFormat: best-of-N rounds against the AI or a 同志
game.spectatorView: shared board overlay with both fields, the next pairs, the chain counter, and the score
game.roundStructure: a round ends on a top-out; the corner advances to the next round or the reveal
game.thirtySecondSummary: 合成fixture: ぷよぷよクローン コーナーの入力契約確認用 planning 例。
game.oneLineSummary: 合成fixture: ぷよぷよクローン コーナーの入力例。

labelsPolicy.fact: confirmed by the board state or the ruleset
labelsPolicy.analysis: interpretation of the position or the expected outcome
labelsPolicy.forecast: conditional prediction of chains or the result

game.limitations: 合成 fixture であり、実試合・実対戦・原作の検証は未実施。
game.uncertainty: 未確認のチェーン結果、操作遅延、対戦相手の選択。
